name: worktree-links
description: Keeps selected gitignored local files linked from a repository's main worktree into its linked worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Share local files across git worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Configures a repository-local allowlist of ignored ordinary files and safely creates absolute symlinks in linked worktrees.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up or repair worktree links for this repository.
